desc:
This is a recreated slime survival game inspired by:
JustinP231's
 -<[ATTACK OF THE SLIMES: BUILD TO SURVIVE!!!]>- 
https://www.roblox.com/games/1845318/

This was created so that we can still enjoy the game that was created in 2008!

For those who have never tried JustinP231's game, note that this game has strayed significantly from the classic. However, the game will still give a good representation on how the classic version went.

Boss waves:
Wizard: 5, King Slime: 10, Ancient Giant: 15, Slime Army General's Tank: 20, Space fleet: 25.

Liked the game? Don't forget to leave a Thumbs Up(👍) and Favorite(🌟) . Thank you!

Join the group for a FREE member label and game perks!
